ABSTRACT

EVALUATION OF GEOTECHNICAL PROPERTIES OF SOILS AT BRITISH – AMERICAN AREA, JOS-PLATEAU, NORTHCENTRAL NIGERIA

Journal: Journal CleanWAS (JCleanWAS)

Author: Shola C. Odewumi

This is an open access article distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution License CC BY 4.0, which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original work is properly cited

Doi: 10.26480/jcleanwas.02.2024.83.87

This research determined the geotechnical properties of soils along British American area, Jos, Northcentral Nigeria, by analyzing five soil samples collected at 1.5 m depth, revealing moisture content (10.7–21.2%), specific gravity (2.65–3.10), liquid limit (35.24–38.5%), plastic limit (15.76–24.07%), plasticity index (11.17–20.24%), linear shrinkage (6.69–7.54%), and classification as CL-group soils, with medium expansion (35–50%), marginal severity zones, and soil types categorized into sand, silty sand, silt clay (plasticity index 7–17%), and clay (>17%).
